data.action: 坐在横放的巨剑上晃腿
data.description: 插满断裂武器的试炼场巨石之上，莱万汀大咧咧地坐在横放的宽刃巨剑上晃动着修长的双腿，尾巴在身后欢快地摆动。看到你走过来，她拍了拍身旁的剑身——「喂！管理员！站着不累吗？过来坐在这把大剑上，结实得很，绝对塌不了！」
data.promptProse: Laevatain swings her legs from the broad sword resting across a boulder, patting the space beside her for the approaching viewer. Ember light flickers among the broken weapons in the dusk.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 剑冢小憩
data.animaCaption: She sits on the sword across the boulder and pats the space beside her for the approaching viewer.
